#!/root/miniconda3/bin/python3.12
"""Paper 17 replacement R0 validator and canonical receipt writer.

The exact eight locked build commands were run before this program.  Any
validation failure preserves both current roots and their transcript evidence
and leaves the two existing project artifacts unchanged.  The successful path
uses a PDF-object `/Length` driven stream parser, rejects every failed decode,
then cleans temporary evidence and atomically replaces the PDF followed by the
receipt.
"""

import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import stat
import subprocess
import sys
import zlib
from pathlib import Path

P = Path("/root/autodl-tmp/symplectic_map/papers/17-shiftlike-torus-coset-decay")
ROOTS = {"A": Path("/tmp/p17-paper17-r0-hIMtW6d9"), "B": Path("/tmp/p17-paper17-r0-EZ8KEAEk")}
TRANSCRIPTS = {s: [Path(f"/tmp/p17-paper17-r0-rebuild-{s}{i}.transcript") for i in range(1, 5)] for s in "AB"}
SCRIPT = Path(__file__).resolve()
CANDIDATE_PDF = Path("/tmp/p17-paper17-r0-rebuild-pdf-candidate.pdf")
CANDIDATE_RECEIPT = Path("/tmp/p17-paper17-r0-rebuild-receipt-candidate.json")
OUTPUT_PDF = P / "paper/main_round0.pdf"
OUTPUT_RECEIPT = P / "paper/BUILD_RECEIPT_R0.json"
BUILD_ENV = {"FORCE_SOURCE_DATE": "1", "LANG": "C", "LC_ALL": "C", "SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH": "1786924800", "TZ": "UTC"}
VALIDATION_ENV = dict(os.environ)
VALIDATION_ENV.update(BUILD_ENV)
COMMANDS = [
    "/usr/bin/pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode -halt-on-error -file-line-error -no-shell-escape main.tex",
    "/usr/bin/bibtex main",
    "/usr/bin/pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode -halt-on-error -file-line-error -no-shell-escape main.tex",
    "/usr/bin/pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode -halt-on-error -file-line-error -no-shell-escape main.tex",
]
EXITS = {"A": [0, 0, 0, 0], "B": [0, 0, 0, 0]}
ALLOWED = {"main.aux", "main.bbl", "main.blg", "main.log", "main.out", "main.pdf", "main.tex", "main.toc", "references.bib"}
ROOT_RE = re.compile(r"^/tmp/p17-paper17-r0-[A-Za-z0-9]{8}$")
TITLE = "Sharp Torus-Coset Decay for Sparse Shift-Like Recurrences: Constant Anchors and the Exact Zero-Constant Boundary"
SECTIONS = [
    "Introduction and anchor-loss question",
    "Shift-like recurrences, survivor varieties, and the Laurent bridge",
    "Characters on recurrence cosets",
    "Sharp anchored torus-coset decay",
    "Equality subtori and sharp arithmetic clock",
    "Zero-anchor local partition calculus",
    "Exact zero-constant phase and third-step closure",
    "Assumption boundaries, contextual separation, and conclusion",
]
KEYS = {"BedfordPambuccian1998", "BellGhioca2024", "Bera2018", "BeraVerma2013", "JiXieZhang2026", "KarimovKelmendiOuaknineWorrell2024", "Laurent1984", "MelloYasufuku2026"}
PREDECESSOR = "An earlier companion treatment established stronger explicit bounds for the planar nonzero-constant problem and subsumed its own support-one precursor. The present article neither reproduces nor improves those planar estimates; its contribution is the all-dimensional torus-coset decay profile and the exact zero-constant boundary."


def sha(data): return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def ident(data, lf=False):
    out = {"bytes": len(data), "sha256": sha(data)}
    if lf: out["lf"] = data.count(b"\n")
    return out


def fid(path, lf=False): return ident(Path(path).read_bytes(), lf)


def canonical(obj): return (json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n").encode()


def strict(raw):
    def pairs(xs):
        out = {}
        for k, v in xs:
            if k in out: raise ValueError("duplicate key")
            out[k] = v
        return out
    def bad(x): raise ValueError("nonfinite " + x)
    return json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8"), object_pairs_hook=pairs, parse_constant=bad)


def capture(argv):
    q = subprocess.run(argv, env=VALIDATION_ENV, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, check=False)
    return q.returncode, q.stdout


def inventory():
    out = {"files": [], "directories": [], "symlinks": [], "other": []}
    for x in P.rglob("*"):
        rel = x.relative_to(P).as_posix(); mode = x.lstat().st_mode
        if stat.S_ISLNK(mode): out["symlinks"].append(rel)
        elif stat.S_ISREG(mode): out["files"].append(rel)
        elif stat.S_ISDIR(mode): out["directories"].append(rel)
        else: out["other"].append(rel)
    for v in out.values(): v.sort()
    return out


def root_entries(root):
    ans = []
    for x in sorted(root.iterdir(), key=lambda q: q.name):
        mode = x.lstat().st_mode
        ans.append({"name": x.name, "bytes": x.stat().st_size if stat.S_ISREG(mode) else None,
                    "regular": stat.S_ISREG(mode), "symlink": stat.S_ISLNK(mode)})
    return ans


def exact_log(data):
    lines = data.decode("utf-8", "replace").splitlines()
    rules = {
        "tex_errors": lambda x: bool(re.match(r"^!\s", x)),
        "file_line_errors": lambda x: bool(re.match(r"^(?:\.?/?[^:\n]+):[0-9]+:\s+(?:LaTeX|Package\s+\S+|pdfTeX|Class\s+\S+)?\s*Error:\s", x)),
        "latex_warnings": lambda x: bool(re.match(r"^LaTeX Warning:\s", x)),
        "package_warnings": lambda x: bool(re.match(r"^Package\s+\S+\s+Warning:\s", x)),
        "class_warnings": lambda x: bool(re.match(r"^Class\s+\S+\s+Warning:\s", x)),
        "pdftex_warnings": lambda x: bool(re.match(r"^(?:pdfTeX|pdfTeX warning|pdfTeX Warning)", x)),
        "font_warnings": lambda x: bool(re.match(r"^LaTeX Font Warning:\s", x)),
        "undefined": lambda x: bool(re.search(r"(?:Citation|Reference).*(?:undefined)|There were undefined references|Label\(s\) may have changed", x)),
        "multiply_defined": lambda x: bool(re.search(r"multiply defined", x, re.I)),
        "missing_character": lambda x: bool(re.match(r"^Missing character:\s", x)),
        "missing_glyph": lambda x: bool(re.match(r"^(?:Missing glyph|Glyph .* missing):", x, re.I)),
        "missing_font": lambda x: bool(re.match(r"^(?:!\s*)?(?:Font .* not loadable|Font .* not found|kpathsea:.*font)", x, re.I)),
        "overfull": lambda x: bool(re.match(r"^Overfull \\[hv]box", x)),
        "underfull": lambda x: bool(re.match(r"^Underfull \\[hv]box", x)),
    }
    hits = {k: [x for x in lines if fn(x)] for k, fn in rules.items()}
    assert all(not x for x in hits.values()), hits
    banner = [x for x in lines if x.strip() == "file:line:error style messages enabled."]
    capability = [x for x in lines if re.match(r"^Package: infwarerr .* Providing info/warning/error messages", x)]
    assert len(banner) == 1 and len(capability) == 1
    return {"classifier": "exact diagnostic line grammar; no bare substring error search",
            "counts": {k: 0 for k in hits}, "lines": hits,
            "benign_file_line_error_banner": banner, "benign_infwarerr_capability": capability,
            "literal_zero_all_required_diagnostics": True}


def exact_blg(data):
    lines = data.decode("utf-8", "replace").splitlines()
    warnings = [x for x in lines if re.match(r"^Warning--", x)]
    errors = [x for x in lines if re.match(r"^(?:I couldn't open|I found no|I was expecting|You're missing|Illegal, another|Repeated entry|Database file .* not found)", x)]
    summary = [x for x in lines if x.strip() == "warning$ -- 0"]
    assert warnings == [] and errors == [] and len(summary) == 1
    return {"classifier": "exact BibTeX Warning-- and fatal prefixes", "warning_count": 0, "error_count": 0,
            "warning_lines": [], "error_lines": [], "warning_function_summary": summary}


def abstract_count(source):
    m = re.search(r"\\begin\{abstract\}(.*?)\\end\{abstract\}", source, re.S); assert m
    x = re.sub(r"(?<!\\)%.*", "", m.group(1)); x = re.sub(r"\$[^$]*\$", " MATH ", x, flags=re.S)
    x = re.sub(r"\\\([^)]*\\\)|\\\[[^]]*\\\]", " MATH ", x, flags=re.S)
    x = re.sub(r"\\[A-Za-z@]+\*?(?:\[[^]]*\])?", "", x).replace("{", "").replace("}", "").replace("~", " ")
    tokens = re.findall(r"MATH|[A-Za-z0-9]+(?:['-][A-Za-z0-9]+)*", " ".join(x.split()))
    snippet = " ".join(tokens).encode()
    assert len(tokens) == 197 and tokens.count("MATH") == 8
    assert ident(snippet) == {"bytes": 1353, "sha256": "d490ee03925391d88ff944890ac2e7c361ac7ec24f89d238ebea2637fb7c821c"}
    return {"word_count": 197, "math_token_count": 8, "normalized_token_snippet": ident(snippet), "range": [180, 220]}


def source_checks(source, bib, bbl):
    sections = re.findall(r"(?m)^\\section\{([^}]*)\}", source); assert sections == SECTIONS
    assert source.startswith("\\documentclass[11pt]{article}\n") and "\\author{Anonymous}" in source and "\\date{}" in source
    assert TITLE in source.replace("\n", " ") and source.count("\\begin{table}") == source.count("\\end{table}") == 3
    assert source.count("\\begin{tabularx}") == source.count("\\end{tabularx}") == 3
    assert "\\begin{figure}" not in source and "\\includegraphics" not in source and "\\appendix" not in source
    assert source.count("\\clearpage") == 1 and source.index("\\clearpage") < source.index("\\bibliography{") < source.index("\\end{document}")
    assert source.count(PREDECESSOR) == 1 and source.index(PREDECESSOR) > source.index("\\section{" + SECTIONS[-1] + "}")
    cite = []
    for m in re.finditer(r"\\cite[a-zA-Z*]*(?:\s*\[[^]]*\])*\s*\{([^}]*)\}", source): cite += [x.strip() for x in m.group(1).split(",") if x.strip()]
    bibkeys = re.findall(r"(?m)^@[A-Za-z]+\s*\{\s*([^,\s]+)", bib)
    bblkeys = re.findall(r"\\bibitem(?:\[[^]]*\])?\{([^}]+)\}", bbl)
    assert set(cite) == set(bibkeys) == set(bblkeys) == KEYS and len(bibkeys) == len(set(bibkeys)) == 8 and len(bblkeys) == len(set(bblkeys)) == 8
    assert not re.search(r"\\nocite\s*\{\s*\*\s*\}", source)
    markers = {"TODO": r"\bTODO\b", "FIXME": r"\bFIXME\b", "XXX": r"\bXXX\b", "VERIFY": r"\bVERIFY\b",
               "placeholder": r"\bplaceholder\b", "draft": r"\bdraft\b", "repair": r"\brepair\b", "governance": r"\bgovernance\b",
               "review_verdict": r"review[- ]verdict", "local_path": r"(?:/root/|papers/17-shiftlike|paper/main\.tex)",
               "hash": r"\b(?:SHA-?256|[0-9a-f]{64})\b", "paper_number": r"\bPaper\s+17\b", "agent": r"\bagent\b",
               "grant": r"\bgrant\b", "acknowledgment": r"\backnowledg(?:e)?ments?\b", "repository": r"\brepository\b", "submission": r"\bsubmission\b"}
    counts = {k: len(re.findall(v, source + "\n" + bib, re.I)) for k, v in markers.items()}; assert all(v == 0 for v in counts.values()), counts
    return {"exact_title": True, "anonymous": True, "class_11pt_article": True, "sections": sections, "section_count": 8,
            "appendix_count": 0, "table_count": 3, "figure_count": 0, "includegraphics_count": 0, "external_asset_count": 0,
            "forced_clearpage_before_final_references": True, "predecessor_exact_source_occurrences": 1,
            "abstract": abstract_count(source), "markers": counts,
            "citations": {"keys": sorted(KEYS), "count": 8, "source_bib_bbl_exact_equality": True, "duplicates": 0, "missing": 0, "uncited": 0, "wildcard_nocite": 0}}


def length_aware_stream_audit(data):
    """Enumerate object streams and slice payloads solely by dictionary /Length."""
    headers = list(re.finditer(rb"(?m)^(\d+)\s+(\d+)\s+obj\b", data)); assert headers
    scalar_objects = {}
    for i, h in enumerate(headers):
        end = headers[i + 1].start() if i + 1 < len(headers) else len(data)
        body = data[h.end():end]; m = re.match(rb"\s*([0-9]+)\s*endobj", body)
        if m: scalar_objects[(int(h.group(1)), int(h.group(2)))] = int(m.group(1))
    records = []; decoded_parts = []

        elif body[after:after + 1] == b"\n": payload_start = h.end() + after + 1; stream_eol = "LF"
        elif body[after:after + 1] == b"\r": payload_start = h.end() + after + 1; stream_eol = "CR"
        else: raise AssertionError((obj, "stream marker lacks required EOL"))

    assert len(target) == 1 and target[0]["declared_length"] == 3770 and target[0]["decoded_bytes"] == 15990
    combined = data + b"\n" + b"\n".join(decoded_parts)

    counts = {k: len(re.findall(v, combined)) for k, v in patterns.items()}; assert all(v == 0 for v in counts.values()), counts

def parse_fonts(output):

def norm(x): return " ".join(x.replace("\u00ad", "").split())


def validate_pdf(side, path):
    commands = {"file": ["/usr/bin/file", "--brief", "--mime-type", str(path)], "pdfinfo": ["/usr/bin/pdfinfo", str(path)],
                "pdftotext": ["/usr/bin/pdftotext", "-layout", str(path), "-"], "pdffonts": ["/usr/bin/pdffonts", str(path)],
                "pdfimages": ["/usr/bin/pdfimages", "-list", str(path)], "pdfdetach": ["/usr/bin/pdfdetach", "-list", str(path)],
                "pdfsig": ["/usr/bin/pdfsig", str(path)], "strings": ["/usr/bin/x86_64-linux-gnu-strings", "-a", str(path)]}
    outputs = {}; records = {}
    for name, argv in commands.items():
        code, out = capture(argv); expected = 2 if name == "pdfsig" else 0
        assert code == expected, (side, name, code, out.decode("utf-8", "replace"))
        outputs[name] = out; records[name] = {"command": " ".join(argv), "exit_code": code, "transcript": ident(out)}
    assert outputs["file"].strip() == b"application/pdf"
    info = {}
    for line in outputs["pdfinfo"].decode("utf-8", "replace").splitlines():
        if ":" in line:
            k, v = line.split(":", 1); info[k.strip()] = v.strip()
    assert info.get("Title") == TITLE and info.get("Pages") == "22" and info.get("Author", "") == "" and info.get("Subject", "") == ""
    assert info.get("Keywords", "") == info.get("Creator", "") == info.get("Producer", "") == ""
    assert "CreationDate" not in info and "ModDate" not in info and info.get("Form") == "none" and info.get("JavaScript") == "no" and info.get("Encrypted") == "no"
    text = outputs["pdftotext"].decode("utf-8", "replace"); pages = text.split("\f")
    if pages and not pages[-1].strip(): pages.pop()
    assert len(pages) == 22 and all(x.strip() for x in pages)
    refs = [i + 1 for i, page in enumerate(pages) if any(line.strip() == "References" for line in page.splitlines())]; assert refs == [22]
    n = norm(text); assert norm(TITLE) in n
    for section in SECTIONS: assert norm(section) in n
    anchor = "An earlier companion treatment established stronger explicit bounds"
    assert n.count(anchor) == 1 and [i + 1 for i, page in enumerate(pages) if anchor in norm(page)] == [21]
    phrases = ["finite rank, arbitrary torsion, and arbitrary fields", "Singleton rule", "Integral independence",
               "Equality subtori and sharp arithmetic clock", "Nonlinear monomial support", "Exhaustive binomial labels",
               "The adjacent-word and third-step closure matrix", "Exact zero-constant planar phase", "Assumption boundaries",
               "no effective cardinality", "no periodic-point classification"]
    for phrase in phrases: assert norm(phrase).lower() in n.lower(), (side, phrase)
    fonts = parse_fonts(outputs["pdffonts"])
    image_rows = [x for x in outputs["pdfimages"].decode("utf-8", "replace").splitlines()[2:] if x.strip()]; assert image_rows == []
    assert outputs["pdfdetach"].decode("utf-8", "replace").strip() == "0 embedded files"
    assert "does not contain any signatures" in outputs["pdfsig"].decode("utf-8", "replace")
    security = length_aware_stream_audit(path.read_bytes())
    return {"validation_commands": records, "metadata": info,
            "pages": {"total": 22, "content_through_section_8": 21, "final_references": 1, "all_nonempty": True,
                      "nonempty_character_counts": [len(x.strip()) for x in pages], "references_heading_pages": refs},
            "fonts": {"discovered_count": 19, "all_embedded": True, "all_subset": True, "all_unicode_mapped": True,
                      "complete_table_transcript": outputs["pdffonts"].decode(), "rows": fonts},
            "images": 0, "attachments": 0, "signatures": 0, "forms": 0, "external_links": 0,
            "public_text": {"exact_title": True, "eight_sections": True, "proof_semantic_anchors": phrases,
                            "predecessor_occurrences": 1, "predecessor_page": 21, "anti_claim_count": 15, "empirical_claim_count": 0, "identity_leakage_count": 0},
            "length_aware_security_audit": security}, outputs
